meta.title: 1:1 voice and video calls: dual Home Station signaling + WebRTC media
meta.subtitle: Ring/accept/end are sealed envelopes posted to each peer's own Home Station: local EventBus when both peers share a Station, federated realtime routing across Stations. Stations relay opaque payloads and never hold keys. Media is end-to-end DTLS-SRTP, direct first with TURN fallback.

cards.title: Signaling path and signaling/media separation
items: Ring, accept, SDP and hangup post as sealed envelopes (X25519 + HKDF + AES-256-GCM) to each peer's own Home Station; Stations relay opaque payloads and never hold keys.
When the recipient is homed remotely, /federation/realtime/signal forwards the frame and the peer verifies claims before local EventBus fan-out; same-Station delivery is local only.

Multi-device ringing and the winning-device resolution live at the callee Home Station; cross-Station winner reads use /federation/realtime/call-resolution. Audio/video runs over browser WebRTC, independent of the Stations.

cards.title: Fallback and recovery
items: On an ICE drop the call enters reconnecting: only the offerer sends an ICE restart; recovery must land within 20s or it ends network-failed.
Ringing auto-sends CALL_END after 45s; a permission failure rejects with media-failed so the caller never waits out the timeout.

cards.title: Group calls differ
items: Group voice/video is not a P2P mesh: clients obtain a LiveKit SFU grant from Station and connect to the SFU. See the group-call journey.
